author: krisoshea.eth
content:
Hey everyone, I hope you are all well. Dropping my Week 13 update here.

A good chunk of the Builder work Marko and I have been doing got merged this week. Nico reviewed and merged the beacon block observer, bid ledger, proposer preferences tracker and lifecycle tests, and Marko's payload store and bid policy PRs went in too, including the store tests and bid arithmetic I'd contributed.

With the ledger in I've taken bid publication, bid selection and envelope publication out of draft, and opened a follow-up from Nico's review so the Builder opens one event stream instead of one per service. A lot of the week was focused on addressing review feedback on those and the PayloadSource PR, which Marko and Nico both looked at. The main fixes involved letting callers that share an envelope submission cancel independently, and closing a gap in ledger pruning that could have let an expired reservation get signed again.

On my lodestar fork I've moved from the SlotBidder to wiring things into the Builder itself. There's an input consumer that lines up head, payload attributes and proposer preference events by beacon parent and dependent root, the bid services get built at startup behind an opt-in config, and a first pass at selection and reveal. It all runs together in the Builder tests with the Engine and beacon node mocked, so the next step is the CLI and Engine config and running it for real.

On the Beacon APIs side, Nico was positive about the new builder related spec write-up so I opened the discussion PR proposing builder_index and block_hash on the block event from Gloas, with the lighter bid_included event as the alternative. I also fixed a race in the unknown-block sync simulation that was failing CI, which Nazar and Nico have approved, and kept the docs and issue board up to date.

I hope you all have a great week, cheers!
